query:
WITH latest_removed AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (ora.account_id)
                ora.account_id,
                ora.removed_at
            FROM organization_researched_accounts ora
            WHERE ora.organization_id = $1
              AND ora.removed_at IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY ora.account_id, ora.removed_at DESC
         )
         SELECT
            oa.account_id AS "account_id!",
            a.name AS "account_name!",
            a.website,
            a.country,
            lr.removed_at AS latest_removed_at
         FROM organization_accounts oa
         INNER JOIN accounts a ON a.id = oa.account_id
         LEFT JOIN latest_removed lr
           ON lr.account_id = oa.account_id
         WHERE oa.organization_id = $1
           AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM organization_researched_accounts active
                WHERE active.organization_id = oa.organization_id
                  AND active.account_id = oa.account_id
                  AND active.removed_at IS NULL
            )
         ORDER BY lower(a.name) ASC, a.name ASC, oa.account_id ASC
